name: AgentOfficeProjectMemory
description: Long-term project memory for Agent Office. Actor IDs are generated from project and a one-way user hash.

semanticMemoryStrategy.name: ProjectFacts
semanticMemoryStrategy.description: Extract durable, project-scoped technical facts, verified decisions, constraints, open risks, and accepted outcomes. Never retain credentials, access tokens, passwords, secret values, or personally identifying data.

summaryMemoryStrategy.name: ProjectSessionSummaries
summaryMemoryStrategy.description: Summarize the work completed, evidence reviewed, unresolved questions, and next actions for a project session. Never retain credentials, access tokens, passwords, secret values, or personally identifying data.
